{{Quote|What in the world would make you think I would know where to find a criminal? Do I strike you as bad somehow?|Kelia Freen to a bounty hunter|audio=KeliaFreen.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Kelia Freen''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Freen had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair, orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and tan skin. They were [[Clothing/Legends|clothed]] in a black outfit with white and light green accents. The outfit consisted of a jacket with a puffy collar, long pants, and a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]]. Freen styled their hair into a ponytail and wore purple makeup on their lips and around their eyes.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
In the latter half of [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.3}}</ref> Kelia Freen was present near a [[Hologame table/Legends|hologame table]] inside a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] when they were approached by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] on contract with the [[Bounty Brokers Association]]. Freen was requested to provide information about a criminal that the hunter was searching for. For a moment, Freen flirted with the hunter before supplying the needed information.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rise_of_the_Hutt_Cartel.png|thumb|right|200px|Kelia Freen debuted in ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel''.]]
Kelia Freen appears in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], an expansion to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', during the recurring Bounty Contract Week event<ref name="TOR" /> introduced in [[2013]] in Update 2.3.<ref name="2.3">{{TORweb/Patch|2.3}}</ref> The event is available to players aligned with either the Republic or the Empire and features Freen as one of several rotating characters that are randomly selected to appear during the event's Bounty Contract daily missions. The missions can take place on a variety of randomly selected worlds, including [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Voss]]. Freen has the potential to appear at any of these locations, but is always found in a cantina and can be summoned by the player by interacting with a hologame table.<ref name="TOR" />

Freen and their male counterpart, [[Dekk'lar]], were created to be brief romance options with player characters of any gender as they progress through the Bounty Contract missions.<ref name="TOR" /> Freen is known as "​seductive_siren" in the game's files.<ref name="Kelia Data">While not visible in-game, Kelia Freen's internal name in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' can be seen here: {{WebCite|url=https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/kelia-freen|text=Kelia Freen|work=[[Jedipedia]].net's SWTOR Database|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/vYprS}}</ref>

The cutscene in which Freen appears opens with them flirting with the player. The player is then presented with [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]], [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], and neutral response options. The player can choose to reason with or threaten Freen by selecting the light side and dark side options respectively. The neutral response option allows players to reciprocate Freen's advances. Regardless of the choice made, Freen provides the player with the information necessary to progress in the mission.<ref name="TOR" />
